dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 style, likely compiled with GnuCOBOL on a PC/Linux environment given LINE SEQUENTIAL files and .TXT extensions; Spanish-language comments and Argentine student context (Serie07Prog04, author Lautaro-Rojas, date 04/10/2022)

purpose.domain_detail: University programming exercise (Serie 07, Program 04) implementing a file-matching (apareo) algorithm between CUENTAS and SERVICIOS files by client number, producing updated accounts, rejections, and incidences files
purpose.summary: This is a student exercise implementing a classic sequential file merge/match (apareo) between two input files: CUENTAS (accounts) and SERVICIOS (services), keyed on client number. It produces three output files: updated accounts, rejections (clients who cannot pay), and incidences (mismatches). The merge logic is partially implemented with debug DISPLAY statements still present.

notable_features: FILE STATUS checking on all open/close/read operations
Centralized error handler paragraph (00010-Mostrar-anulado) with STOP RUN
Extensive debug DISPLAY statements left in code
Incomplete merge logic (some branches only have DISPLAY placeholders)
verdict.notes: The program is clearly a student exercise from an Argentine university course (filename Serie07Prog04, author Lautaro-Rojas, 2022). The merge/apareo logic is incomplete — the equal and greater-than branches in 00000-B lack actual WRITE operations and the PERFORM loop condition in 00050-Apareo appears logically inverted (UNTIL NOT= '10' would never enter if FS is not EOF). Many debug DISPLAY statements remain. No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS.
